main_text.p: nectamus, vinculo nunquam solvendo. Eam ad rem quum pernecessarium & apprime appositum mihi videatur magni istius Junii consilium, non abs re fore sum arbitratus si ex Irenico illius excerptum in vulneratae quin imo exulceratae ecclesiae usum huc reponerem. Pater Domini nostri Jesu Christi, Deus pacis & concordiae efficiat, ut ardentissimo odiorum camino, quibus ecclesia nunc flendum in modum flagrat, oleum irarum affundamus nulli, purissimas vero charitatis aquas, non ad fabriles carbones, qui magis eo inardescunt, sed ad corda Christianorum dissidiis inflammata, incendio tam acerbo tempestive restinguendo afferamus omnes, Amen.

page.notes: Ornament (woodcut device) below the text is not transcribed. The catchword "D. FRAN-" is a printed signature-style line at the foot of the text; it is shown as a foot line. The running head is given as "Ad lectorem." Some letters in the scan are worn; the readings above are the most likely.
